## 4. Decision rules (agreed with owner 2026-08-30)

1. **Binary conflicts (`.uasset`/`.umap`): newest commit wins**, main-side default — main is
   the owner's live material lane. Verify with `git log -1 --format='%ci %h' <branch> -- <file>`.
2. **Owner-contested list overrides rule 1.** Owner names any file where the feature/backup
   side must win, before resolution starts. Current list: *empty*.
3. **Text conflicts:** resolve manually, main-side bias; the post-merge full build is the
   verification gate for every C++ resolution.
4. **Targeted resolution only:** `git checkout --ours/--theirs -- <explicit path>` per file
   during an active merge. **Never** bulk `git checkout -- .` / `git clean` (AGENTS.md red line).
5. Rebase is forbidden on all divergent lines (`--no-ff` merge commits only).

## 5. Procedure

**Preconditions:** editor closed (merge rewrites `.uasset`s the editor holds in memory);
owner WIP checkpoint committed on main; bundle backup current; `python Tools/branch_health.py`
re-run to confirm no new divergent lines appeared.

```powershell
# 1. merge feature (103)
git merge --no-ff --no-commit feature/p0-phase1-allowlist-quill-trigger
# resolve per §4; verify: git status --porcelain | Select-String '^UU'
git commit -m "merge: consolidate feature/p0-phase1-allowlist-quill-trigger (103 commits) into main"

# 2. merge backup (75) — same pattern
# 3..7: remaining order per §2
```

**Abort paths:** pre-commit → `git merge --abort`; post-commit → `git revert -m 1 <merge-sha>`
(single revert, never history rewrite). Branch refs are never deleted, so every line remains
individually recoverable.

**Post-merge verification gates (merge is not done until these pass):**
1. Full closed-editor build (Safe Rule 21 — owed since `694b7250` regardless).
2. `python Tools/bp_sweep.py` scoped + `python Docs/T3D_Baseline/verify_baseline.py`.
3. `python Tools/branch_health.py --conflicts` → confirm consolidation complete.
4. Fresh `static_gates` ledger row (the 08-29 pass certified the pre-merge tree — now stale).
5. Push `main` + all consolidated branch refs to origin (or `Tools/push_queue.ps1` when connectivity returns).
